blocks.text: Metals hard (sakht) aur rigid (akri hui) substances hain jo heat aur electricity ke achhe conductors (guzarne dene wale) hain. Yeh malleable (chadar ban jane wale) aur ductile (taar ban jane wale) hain, is liye inhein toote baghair aasani se sheets (chadaron) mein ya wires (taaron) mein badla ja sakta hai. Isi liye metals construction aur industries mein use hoti hain. Steel apni strength (mazbooti) ki wajah se bridges (pulon) aur buildings (imaraton) mein lagta hai. Aluminium light-weight (halka) hai, is liye aircraft ki bodies mein use hota hai, aur copper ki conductivity bohat achhi hai, is liye electric wires (bijli ki taaron) mein use hota hai.

Metals zyada tar earth crust (zameen ki oopar wali parat) mein milti hain. Kam reactive metals, jaise gold aur platinum, free state mein milti hain, yani nature mein metal ki shakal mein, aur doosre elements ke saath aksar compounds nahi banatin. Zyada reactive metals, jaise sodium, aluminium, iron aur copper, combined state (compounds ki shakal) mein ores ki form mein milti hain. Maslan hematite (Fe₂O₃) iron ki ore hai jo duniya ke kuch hisson mein milti hai. Metal ores zameen ki crust mein alag alag quantities (miqdar) mein phaili hui hain. Ores pure (khalis) compounds nahi hotin; yeh desired (chahiye wale) metal compound, impurities (milawat) aur mitti jaise earthly materials ka mixture hoti hain. Is mitti wale hisse ko gangue kehte hain. Aisi metals physical aur chemical processes ki aik series se ores se nikali jati hain.
Extraction of metals (metals nikalna): Metallurgy

blocks.title: Metallurgy
blocks.text: Metallurgy woh science hai jis mein metals ko un ki ores se nikala jata hai aur behtar use ke liye pure (khalis) banaya jata hai.
Metal kitni reactive hai aur kis qism ki hai, isi se extraction ka tareeqa tay hota hai.
Metallurgy mein kai steps hote hain jin ke baad metal apni sab se pure form mein milti hai.
i. Mining
Mining (kaan kani) woh step hai jis mein zameen mein gehrai par dabi hui metal ores nikali jati hain, maslan iron ki ores.
Kitab ki Figure 31.2 do tasveerein hain: baen taraf iron ore (haematite) ki mining, aur daen taraf haematite ka aik tukra.
ii. Ore concentration (ore ko saaf karna)
Ore concentration mein ore ko jitna ho sake impurities (milawat) se saaf kiya jata hai.
iii. Concentrated ore ko metal oxide mein badalna
Yeh aam taur par do tareeqon se hota hai. Pehla tareeqa roasting hai: metal ki sulphide ore ko excess (zyada) air mein garam kiya jata hai.
Doosra tareeqa calcination hai: metal ki carbonate ore ko bohat kam hawa ya baghair hawa ke garam kiya jata hai taake woh oxide ban jaye.
iv. Metal oxide ko metal mein reduce karna

Metal oxide ka reduction (oxygen hatana) extraction ka sab se ahem step hai. Har metal ke liye us ki reactivity ke hisaab se alag technique use hoti hai. Kam reactive metals (jo reactivity series mein carbon se neeche hain) ke liye carbon reducing agent hai. Carbon pehle CO banta hai, phir CO metal oxide se react karti hai. Carbon monoxide metal oxide se oxygen le leti hai aur free metal bach jati hai. Iron ore ka reduction is tarah hota hai:

Jo metals carbon se zyada reactive hain un par yeh tareeqa kaam nahi karta, kyunke carbon un ke oxides reduce nahi kar sakta. Aisi metals ke liye electrolytic method (electrolysis) use hota hai: metal compound ko melt kar (pighla kar) us mein electric current guzara jata hai, jis mein bohat energy lagti hai. Yeh tareeqa bohat reactive metals (maslan Na, K, Al, jo carbon se aasani se reduce nahi hotin) nikalne ke liye zaruri hai, aur kam reactive metals (maslan Cu) ko bohat zyada pure banane ke liye bhi. Positive metal ions negative electrode (cathode) ki taraf jate hain, wahan electrons le kar metal ban jate hain.
v. Metal ki refining

Reduction ke baad milne wale sample mein aksar metal ka percentage kafi zyada hota hai. Lekin kuch khaas kaamon ke liye metal bohat zyada pure chahiye. Maslan electrical wiring ke liye copper 99.99% pure hona chahiye. Aakhri step purification (safai) hai jis se pure metal milti hai aur phir kaam mein lai jati hai. Metal ko thermal, chemical ya electrochemical tareeqon se refine kiya ja sakta hai.
vi. Alloying of metals (metals ko milana)

Alloying mein do ya zyada metals ko mila kar homogeneous (har jagah aik jaisa) solution banaya jata hai, ya metal ko kisi non-metal ke saath milaya jata hai. Is se metal ki microstructure badal jati hai aur us ki properties behtar hoti hain, jaise strength, corrosion resistance (zang se bachao), aur electrical ya magnetic properties. Aam alloys aur un ke uses Table 31.1 mein hain.

blocks.prompt: Sodium electrolysis se kyun nikala jata hai, carbon se reduction se kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Sodium carbon se zyada reactive hai, is liye carbon us ke compounds ko reduce nahi kar sakta. Is liye pighle hue sodium compound mein current guzar kar (electrolysis) sodium nikala jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Roasting aur calcination mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono mein ore metal oxide ban jati hai. Farq:

rows: Sulphide ore garam ki jati hai
Carbonate ore garam ki jati hai
Bohat kam air mein ya baghair air ke
ZnCO₃ → ZnO + CO₂ (CO₂ gas nikalti hai)

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Metallurgy ke steps: mining, ore concentration, roasting ya calcination, reduction, refining, alloying.
Carbon se kam reactive metals: CO se reduction (Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂).
Carbon se zyada reactive metals (Na, K, Al): electrolysis.
Alloys (brass, bronze, steel, duralumin) metal ki properties behtar karte hain.
